blockingIssues.description: The reviewed feature evidence run did not include explicit post-login `systemctl --failed --no-pager` outputs and recorded a warning class-diff command exit code of 1, so required cross-assertion evidence was not fully satisfied in that feature review.
The reviewed feature commit introduced a `gocritic/hugeParam` regression (`GetKernelRepoEnablements` passed `values.System` by value), making that feature review fail at the commit level.

Deferred arm64 boot commands are not fully executable as written: post-boot checks rely on a QEMU monitor socket that is never created and no concrete guest-access path is wired for running required health-check commands.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update the environment-constraints section to reflect current QEMU availability in this sandbox, since multiple completed validation features successfully executed `/usr/libexec/qemu-kvm` despite the file stating host QEMU binaries are unavailable.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The review for `amd64-boot-postlogin-healthcheck-evidence` references successful QEMU-backed post-login capture while mission guidance still declares QEMU unavailable.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add explicit deferred arm64 boot command quality checks to require a concrete, executable guest-access mechanism and complete post-boot health-check command path (not commented examples).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The review for `arm64-build-validate-and-boot-deferral-policy` found blocking command-executability gaps in the deferred boot instructions.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify startup expectations when `.factory/services.yaml` is absent (e.g., fallback command-discovery flow), because multiple reviewers flagged missing services manifest assumptions.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: All eight scrutiny reports independently flagged missing `.factory/services.yaml` as a shared-state friction point.

rejectedObservations.observation: Missing in-repo `runtime-worker` or `validation-worker` SKILL.md files should be treated as a repository defect.
rejectedObservations.reason: ambiguous: mission runs can rely on built-in/personal skills outside this repository, so absence of in-repo skill docs is not necessarily incorrect state.

rejectedObservations.observation: Missing `.factory/services.yaml` should always be treated as a blocking defect.
rejectedObservations.reason: rejected: the mission executed successfully without a services manifest by using repository and mission command evidence; this is a guidance/documentation gap rather than a hard blocker.
